input.free_text_description: This system is a job/recommendation platform that serves Employer, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for schedule job, sample. Secondary concerns include messaging functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to browse job listings and receive personalized recommendations, so that I can find relevant career opportunities.
As a Employer, I want to interact with index functionality, so that I can accomplish my index-related tasks.
As a Employer, I want to interact with restful functionality, so that I can accomplish my restful-related tasks.
As a Employer, I want to use sample capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Employer, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
